findings.explanation: Ownership of the products transfers to the Client at the shipping dock before full payment is completed, as the remaining balance and royalties are due after shipment.
findings.suggested_change: Title to the products shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has received full payment of all amounts due for such products.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the agreement. I have reviewed the terms and would like to request a few adjustments before signing. - Regarding the relevant clause where ownership transfers at the shipping dock, this occurs before full payment is completed; I propose that title to the products shall remain with the Contractor until the Contractor has received full payment of all amounts due for such products. Best regards,
